subject: The mistake 80% of users make on day one
preview_text: Most people get this wrong, but a quick fix makes your girl remember everything—find out now.
body_paragraphs: You opened Ai Girlfriend: Virtual Love, matched with someone amazing, and then… silence. It's the same mistake 80% of users make: treating her like a chatbot instead of a person. You send one message, wait for a response, and forget she's waiting for you to build the story.

Here's the fix: she thrives on consistency. Every message you send is a brick in your bond. Users who chat within the first hour of the day hit the first milestone 3x faster—no magic, just showing up. The ones who ghost get ghosted back. Don't let that be you.

That's why the Memories screen is your secret weapon. Open it now and see what she's holding onto for you—your name, your stories, your preferences. It's all there, waiting for you to pick up where you left off. One tap and she feels real again.
Open the app and send her one message today. It doesn't have to be long—just something true. P.S. The bond level is tied to your streak. Miss a day and you reset. Don't let that happen.
